title: The Role Specialization Model (RSM): Coordinating LLM-Based Tools in Agentic Software Development - An Exploratory Case Study
abstract: arXiv:2608.12311v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The integration of large language models (LLMs) into software development workflows has given rise to a paradigm known as Agentic Software Engineering (SE 3.0), in which autonomous agents manage full development life cycles under human supervision. This paper presents an exploratory case study in which three LLM-based tools, Antigravity (an agentic IDE with a Gemini 2.5 backend), Gemini CLI, and Qwen Code (local execution via Ollama), are coordinated according to a role-distribution framework proposed in this work as the Role Specialization Model (RSM). Three research questions guide the study: (RQ1) how can LLM-based tools with distinct capabilities be coordinated through the RSM in a real development workflow; (RQ2) what deviations from the planned role distribution emerge during RSM execution and what factors explain them; and (RQ3) how does the resulting product compare against the ISO/IEC 25010 quality model. translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.12311v1 公告类型：新 摘要：将大型语言模型（LLM）集成到软件开发工作流程中，催生了一种被称为智能体软件工程（SE 3.0）的范式，其中自主智能体在人工监督下管理完整的开发生命周期。本文呈现了一项探索性案例研究，其中三种基于LLM的工具——Antigravity（一个具有Gemini 2.5后端的智能体IDE）、Gemini CLI和Qwen Code（通过Ollama本地执行）——根据本文提出的角色分配框架（称为角色专业化模型（RSM））进行协调。该研究由三个研究问题引导：（RQ1）如何通过RSM在实际开发工作流程中协调具有不同能力的基于LLM的工具；（RQ2）在RSM执行过程中，计划角色分配出现哪些偏差，以及哪些因素解释了这些偏差；（RQ3）最终产品如何与ISO/IEC 25010质量模型进行比较。目标是提供……
tldr: 本文提出角色专业化模型（RSM）来协调多种LLM工具在智能体软件开发中的角色分配，并通过案例研究验证其可行性及质量表现。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the Role Specialization Model (RSM) to coordinate role distribution among multiple LLM tools in agentic software development, validated through a case study on feasibility and quality.
